name: Oletrex Microservices
description: API collection for the learn-microservices repo. Base URLs are collection variables (defaults: local ports from application.properties). Requests run top to bottom as a flow.

folders.name: Auth Service
folders.description: Registration, login, service tokens and the public signing keys (port 8086). Run top to bottom: Register stores <<accessToken>>, Admin login stores <<adminToken>>.

requests.name: Register
requests.description: Creates the account and the customer profile, returns a USER token and stores it as <<accessToken>>. Generates a unique <<registerEmail>>.

requests.name: Login
requests.description: Logs in the account created by Register (email is case-insensitive). Run Register first.

requests.name: Admin login
requests.description: Logs in the first admin (ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env, dev defaults shown) and stores <<adminToken>>.

requests.name: Service token (order)
requests.description: Client-credentials token for the order service (SERVICE role). Stores <<serviceToken>>, used by the inventory Deductions requests.

requests.name: JWKS
requests.description: Public signing keys the other services use to verify tokens.

requests.name: Register - duplicate email (409)
requests.description: Same email as Register; run Register first.

requests.name: Login - wrong password (401)
requests.description: Wrong password and unknown email give the same answer.

requests.name: Register - short password (400)
requests.description: Password must be 8-100 characters.

requests.name: List users (admin)
requests.description: ADMIN only. Cursor pagination: pass nextCursor as ?cursor= for the next page. Stores the first USER account's id as <<userId>> for the requests below. Run Admin login first.

requests.name: Promote user to admin
requests.description: ADMIN only. Changes the role of <<userId>> (set by List users). You cannot demote yourself (409). Takes effect when the user next logs in.

requests.name: Disable user
requests.description: ADMIN only. A disabled user cannot log in. You cannot disable yourself (409).

requests.name: Enable user
requests.description: ADMIN only. Re-enables an account disabled with Disable user.

folders.name: Customer Service
folders.description: CustomerController - /api/customers (port 8085). USER tokens use /me; ADMIN lists and reads any customer. Tokens (<<accessToken>>, <<adminToken>>) come from the auth service.

requests.name: Get my profile
requests.description: Returns the profile of the customer in the USER token's customerId claim.

requests.name: Update my profile
requests.description: Updates name, phone and delivery address. Email cannot be changed (any email field is ignored).

requests.name: List customers (admin)
requests.description: ADMIN only. Cursor pagination: pass nextCursor as ?cursor= for the next page.

requests.name: Get customer (admin)
requests.description: ADMIN only.

requests.name: Get my profile - no token (401)
requests.description: Negative case: no Authorization header.

requests.name: List customers as user (403)
requests.description: Negative case: a USER token cannot list customers.

folders.name: Master Data Service
folders.description: MasterDataController - /api/master-data (port 8084). Loads 1 location, 2000 products, their stock and 300 customers from CSV files. Needs an ADMIN token (<<adminToken>>, run Auth Service > Admin login first); auth, customer, product and inventory services must be running.

requests.name: Show CSV summary
requests.description: Row counts in the CSV files that populate would load.

requests.name: Populate master data
requests.description: Creates the CSV records, or resets them to the CSV values if they already exist (customers are registered with MASTERDATA_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD, or logged in as and updated). Takes a few seconds. Needs an ADMIN token: 401 without one, 403 for a user. 503 if the auth, customer, product or inventory service is down; 409 if a run is already in progress.

requests.name: Customer login (seeded)
requests.description: Logs in a customer created by Master Data > Populate (MASTERDATA_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD, dev default shown) and stores <<accessToken>>. Run Populate first.

requests.name: Create Product
requests.description: Creates a product with full details. Pre-request script generates a unique <<skuCode>> so the flow can be re-run. Returns 201 with a Location header.

requests.name: Create Product - duplicate SKU
requests.description: Same SKU as 'Create Product'. Expects 409 'Product Already Exists'.

requests.name: Create Product - validation error
requests.description: Blank SKU/name, negative price, lowercase currency, negative weight, blank attribute. Expects 400.

requests.name: List Products - first page
requests.description: Cursor pagination: first page of 2 products with details. Saves nextCursor into <<productNextCursor>>.

requests.name: List Products - next page
requests.description: Second page, using the nextCursor saved by the previous request. Repeat until hasMore is false.

requests.name: List Products - invalid cursor
requests.description: A cursor that was not issued by the API. Expects 400 'Invalid Cursor'.

requests.name: List Products - limit too large
requests.description: limit must be 1-100. Expects 400.

requests.name: Get Product by SKU
requests.description: Full product including details. 404 if the SKU does not exist.

requests.name: Update Product
requests.description: Replaces the whole product (SKU cannot change). Omitting 'details' removes them; lists replace the existing attributes/images.

requests.name: Delete Product
requests.description: Deletes the product and its details, attributes and images. 204, or 404 if missing.

requests.name: Get Product - not found
requests.description: Run after 'Delete Product': expects 404 'Product Not Found'.

requests.name: Create product as user - 403
requests.description: A USER token may read products but not write: expects 403 ProblemDetail. Run Auth Service > Login first so <<accessToken>> is set.

requests.name: List without token - 401
requests.description: No Authorization header: expects 401 ProblemDetail with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer.

folders.name: Location Service
folders.description: LocationController - /api/locations (inventory service, port 8083). No delete: set active=false.

requests.name: Create Location
requests.description: Creates a warehouse. Generates a unique <<locationCode>>. 201 with Location header.

requests.name: Create Location - duplicate code
requests.description: Same code again. Expects 409 'Location Already Exists'.

requests.name: Create Location - validation error
requests.description: Lowercase code with a space, blank name, 'India' instead of 'IN', negative priority. Expects 400.

requests.name: List Locations - first page
requests.description: Cursor pagination: first page of 2. Saves nextCursor into <<locationNextCursor>>.

requests.name: List Locations - next page
requests.description: Next page, using the saved nextCursor. Repeat until hasMore is false.

requests.name: List Locations - invalid cursor
requests.description: A cursor not issued by the API. Expects 400 'Invalid Cursor'.

requests.name: List Locations - limit too large
requests.description: limit must be 1-100. Expects 400.

requests.name: Get Location by Code
requests.description: 404 if the code does not exist.

requests.name: Update Location - deactivate
requests.description: Replaces everything except the code. active=false retires the location: it keeps its stock records but never supplies orders.

requests.name: Get Location - not found
requests.description: Expects 404 'Location Not Found'.

folders.name: Inventory Service
folders.description: InventoryController - /api/inventory (port 8083). Stock is per SKU and location; the first stock for a SKU calls the product service.

requests.name: Setup - create product
requests.description: Inventory only creates stock for products that exist, so create one first. Generates a unique <<inventorySkuCode>>.

requests.name: Setup - create location 1
requests.description: Creates a warehouse (priority 1). Generates a unique <<invLocation1>>.

requests.name: Setup - create location 2
requests.description: Creates a warehouse (priority 2). Generates a unique <<invLocation2>>.

requests.name: Save Inventory - new SKU (creates)
requests.description: 25 units at location 1. First stock for this SKU, so inventory checks the product service. 201.

requests.name: Save Inventory - second location
requests.description: 10 units of the same SKU at location 2: a new record (201).

requests.name: Save Inventory - unknown product
requests.description: A SKU the product service doesn't know. Expects 422 'Unknown Product'.

requests.name: Save Inventory - unknown location
requests.description: A location code that doesn't exist. Expects 422 'Invalid Location'.

requests.name: Save Inventory - validation error
requests.description: Blank SKU, missing locationCode, negative quantity. Expects 400.

requests.name: Get Inventory by SKU
requests.description: Total across locations plus per-location breakdown (preferred first).

requests.name: Deduct Stock
requests.description: All items from ONE location: location 1 (priority 1) has enough, so 25 - 5 = 20 there.

requests.name: Deduct Stock - no single location
requests.description: 22 units: 30 exist in total (20 + 10) but no single location has 22. Expects 409 'No Single Location'.

requests.name: Deduct Stock - insufficient
requests.description: Includes a SKU with no stock anywhere. Expects 409 'Insufficient Stock' listing it; nothing is deducted.

requests.name: Deduction as admin - 403
requests.description: Deductions are for the SERVICE role only: an admin token is refused.

requests.name: Save Inventory - existing record (updates)
requests.description: Sets location 1 to 0: updates the existing record (200).

requests.name: List Inventory - by location
requests.description: Only records at location 2.

requests.name: List Inventory - first page
requests.description: Cursor pagination: first page of 2. Saves nextCursor into <<inventoryNextCursor>>.

requests.name: List Inventory - next page
requests.description: Next page, using the saved nextCursor. Repeat until hasMore is false.

requests.name: List Inventory - invalid cursor
requests.description: A cursor not issued by the API. Expects 400 'Invalid Cursor'.

requests.name: List Inventory - limit too large
requests.description: limit must be 1-100. Expects 400.

requests.name: Get Inventory - not found
requests.description: A SKU with no records. Expects 404 'Inventory Not Found'.

folders.name: Order Service
folders.description: OrderController - /api/orders (port 8081). Placing an order calls the product and inventory services, so all three must be running.

requests.name: Setup - create product
requests.description: Creates the product the orders below will buy (49.99 USD). Generates a unique <<orderSkuCode>>.

requests.name: Setup - register second user
requests.description: Registers a second customer and stores their token as <<otherUserToken>>, used to show that one user cannot see another's order.

requests.name: Setup - create location
requests.description: Creates a warehouse (priority 1). Generates a unique <<orderLocationCode>>.

requests.name: Setup - add stock
requests.description: Puts 5 units of <<orderSkuCode>> in stock at <<orderLocationCode>>.

requests.name: Create Order
requests.description: As the registered user (<<accessToken>> from Auth Service > Register), places an order for 2 units with shipping and billing addresses. The order service fetches the product (price 49.99 USD), deducts stock in inventory from one location (recorded as fulfilmentLocationCode), and returns 201 with status CONFIRMED, owned by the user's customerId. Saves <<orderNumber>>.

requests.name: Verify stock deducted
requests.description: Stock was 5, the order took 2: expects 3.

requests.name: Create Order - insufficient stock
requests.description: More than in stock. The order is saved as CANCELLED with a reason; returns 422. Stock is unchanged.

requests.name: Create Order - unknown product
requests.description: A SKU the product service doesn't know. Saved as CANCELLED; returns 422.

requests.name: Create Order - validation error
requests.description: Blank SKU and zero quantity. Rejected before anything is saved: 400.

requests.name: Create Order - missing billingAddress (400)
requests.description: No billingAddress: rejected with 400 before anything is saved.

requests.name: Create Order as admin (403)
requests.description: Admins cannot place orders (USER only): 403 Forbidden.

requests.name: List Orders - first page
requests.description: Cursor pagination: first page of 2. Saves nextCursor into <<orderNextCursor>>.

requests.name: List Orders (admin)
requests.description: Admin sees orders of all customers.

requests.name: List Orders - next page
requests.description: Next page, using the nextCursor saved by the previous request. Repeat until hasMore is false.

requests.name: List Orders - invalid cursor
requests.description: A cursor that was not issued by the API. Expects 400 'Invalid Cursor'.

requests.name: List Orders - limit too large
requests.description: limit must be 1-100. Expects 400.

requests.name: Get Order by Number
requests.description: Returns one of the user's own orders. Run 'Create Order' first to populate <<orderNumber>>. 404 if it does not exist or belongs to another customer.

requests.name: Get Order - other user (404)
requests.description: Another customer's order looks like it does not exist: 404 Order Not Found. Run 'Setup - register second user' and 'Create Order' first.

requests.name: Delete Order as user (403)
requests.description: Only admins may delete orders: 403 Forbidden. Run before 'Delete Order'.

requests.name: Delete Order
requests.description: Admin only. Deletes the order and its line items. Returns 204, or 404 if it does not exist.

requests.name: Get Order - not found
requests.description: Run after 'Delete Order': as admin, the deleted order must now return 404 problem detail.
